items.title: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Sees Modest Fair Value Cut As Analysts Trim Targets
items.summary: Albemarle’s fair value estimate has been adjusted from US$158.73 to US$154.68, reflecting a slightly more cautious price target range under the latest assumptions. This change lines up with Street research that has been trimming targets as analysts factor in softer lithium pricing, weaker end markets and higher interest rates, while still seeing support from Albemarle’s cost position and balance sheet.
